description: This file contains code related to source map handling, including functions for encoding, decoding, and managing source map comments, as well as classes for processing CSS with source maps.

classes.name: Converter
classes.description: A class for handling source map encoding, decoding, and conversion between different formats.

classes.name: SafeBuffer
classes.description: A safe wrapper around Node.js Buffer for compatibility.

methods.name: toJSON
methods.description: Serializes the sourcemap to JSON string.

methods.name: toBase64
methods.description: Encodes the sourcemap JSON as a base64 string.

methods.name: toComment
methods.description: Generates a sourceMappingURL comment with the base64-encoded sourcemap.

methods.name: toObject
methods.description: Returns the sourcemap as a JavaScript object.

methods.name: addProperty
methods.description: Adds a property to the sourcemap object, throws if property exists.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Sets a property on the sourcemap object.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a property from the sourcemap object.
